title: Dick Tracy
about: A square-jawed detective takes on Big Boy Caprice's gangsters.
cue: Serve the mains when Big Boy pitches the mob bosses at Club Ritz.
faces: “There was one Napoleon, one Washington, one me!”

    Small PlatesClub Ritz canapésEgg yolk mayo topped with salmon roe, plus prosciutto wrapped asparagusHow to make it6 eggs3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard50g salmon roe1 bunch asparagus100g prosciuttoBoil the eggs hard, cool, peel and halve.Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise and Dijon, pipe back into the whites and top with salmon roe.Blanch the asparagus.Wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.Yellow coat cheese puffsBaked choux puffs with gruyère and a pinch of turmericHow to make it125ml water50g butter75g plain flour2 eggs80g Gruyere, grated1/4 tsp ground turmericBring the water and butter to the boil, beat in the flour and cook for a minute. Cool slightly.Beat in the eggs, then the Gruyere and turmeric.Pipe small mounds onto lined trays.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.SupperBig Boy's spaghettiBig Boy's pitch to the city's head criminals. Meatballs in San Marzano tomato, basilHow to make it600g pork and beef mince2 slices of white bread60ml milk1 egg80g parmesan, grated800g San Marzano tomatoes (2 tins)1 bunch basil500g spaghetti2 tbsp olive oilSoak the bread in the milk, squeeze and mix with the mince, egg and half the parmesan.Roll into balls and brown in the oil.Simmer in the tomatoes with basil.Cook the spaghetti.Toss with the sauce and serve with the rest of the parmesan.Tracy's diner pot roastDinner for a cop with Big Boy still looseHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBeef chuck braised low and slow with onion, carrot, red wine and stock until it falls apart, with buttery potatoes and a glossy gravy.Season a 1.5kg chuck roast and brown it all over in a heavy pot.Add 2 quartered onions, 4 carrots in chunks and 3 garlic cloves.Pour in 250ml red wine and 500ml beef stock, add thyme and bay, cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours.Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more.Lift out the meat and veg and boil the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour slurry until glossy.After the ShowLemon meringue pieSets as hard as Lips Manlis's bath. Tart lemon filling, torched meringueHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry3 lemons300g caster sugar3 tbsp cornflour250ml water3 eggs50g butterLine a tin with the pastry and blind-bake.Cook the lemon juice and zest, half the sugar, cornflour and water until thick.Beat in the egg yolks and butter, then fill the pastry case.Whip the egg whites with the remaining sugar to stiff peaks and pile on top.Torch the meringue until golden.Chill to set.From the BarBreathless Mahoney's gin gimletBreathless sings Sooner or Later.
